reason: A web-based file browser for DeepSeek Harness with file navigation, search, previews, model tools for browsing and reading files, and optional filesystem operations.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网页文件浏览器，支持目录导航、搜索、文件预览以及模型驱动的文件浏览和读取。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web file browser for navigating, searching, previewing, and selectively accessing files through model tools.

capabilities: Browse and search files under configured roots
Read UTF-8 text files through model tools
Create, rename, copy, and delete folders or files when not read-only
Open local files or directories through host system integrations
Launch an agent workspace for one-click file or directory analysis
